_note: Replies when you say Merry Christmas to a stranger on the trails (job merrychristmas). mood: cozy | grumpy | odd | spooked (spooked = night only). vf/vm = voice for female / male strangers. Voice files: voice/trail/merry_<id>_<f|m>.m4a (build/make_merry_voices.py).

lines.text: Merry Christmas! You are the first person I have seen in hours. I am counting that as a present.
Merry Christmas to you too. Listen. The snow is quiet on purpose.
Oh! Merry Christmas. Here, have the last warm thought I was saving.
Merry Christmas. Mind the ice. It is festive, but it has opinions.
Merry Christmas. Yes. Fine. Now let me stand here in peace.
Hmph. Merry Christmas. Do not make it a habit.
It is not Christmas yet. Merry Christmas anyway. Do not tell anyone I said it.
Merry Christmas. The trees said it first, but they mumble.
Merry Christmas. I counted the stars earlier. One of them waved back.
And to you. Somewhere downtown, a clock just agreed with you.
Merry... Christmas. Please keep talking. I would rather hear you than the woods.
Oh! You are real. Good. Merry Christmas. Walk with me for a bit. Not far.
Merry Christmas. Shh. Did you hear that? ... No. Nothing. Merry Christmas.
